svg.aria-label: Firmware connection diagram: each ESP32 GPIO used by the firmware, the PCB connector pin or add-on-board pad it goes through, the interface module, and the device on the rig it drives or reads.
svg.title: Firmware connection diagram E-01
svg.text: G14 = GPIO 14 · pin = U7 socket pin
P-02 · return pump, sump → FT-01 → TK-01
SOV-01 · on/off valve on P-01 suction
FT-01 · flow transmitter on the return line
LSL-03 and ZSO-01 · soldered to unrouted socket pins
TOUCHCAL EMPTY with the probe dry
bare wires at TK-03 dip tube
On the ESP32 board, and the supply pins
12 V: SMPS → PCB 12V INPUT (fuse F3 ≥ 15 A, TVS)
→ P1, P2, P3 to the IBT-2 B+/B− · P4 to the D4184 VIN
5 V: LM2596 → ESP32 5V pin, FT-01 red, SOLENOID_VALVE V
0 V is common to the PCB, every IBT-2 and the D4184
